tabs.label: Settings sections
settings.warning_lead: The settings file had a problem.
general.launch_at_login_hint: Dictate starts in the tray every time you log in, so the shortcut works right away.
general.hotkey_hint: Changing the shortcut isn't possible yet.
general.mode.toggle: Press to start / press again to stop
general.mode.hold: Hold the key to talk, release to stop
general.auto_write: Write into the focused text field
general.auto_write_hint: When you finish talking, Dictate fixes mistakes and punctuation and writes the text into the field you were in. With no field focused, a card opens to edit and copy.
speech.engine_api_hint: The service and its key are set under Accounts & API keys.
models.heading: Whisper models
models.selected_missing: The selected model isn't downloaded yet.
models.note.large-v3-turbo-q5_0: Close to Large v3, compressed to need less memory
models.note.medium: A balance of speed and accuracy
models.note.large-v3-turbo: Close to Large v3, much faster
wav.heading: Test with a WAV file
wav.hint: Paste the full path of a WAV file (16-bit or 32-bit float). The model in use above transcribes it.
ai.auto_refine: Edit with AI automatically when dictation stops
ai.summary_model: Summary model (empty = use the main model)
ai.vocabulary_hint: Names, terms, product names… Used by AI editing and summaries, and as a hint for the transcription API.
accounts.key_placeholder_replace: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
accounts.ai_footer: OpenRouter: choose OpenAI-compatible, base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, models like anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.
accounts.shares_key: Sharing the OpenRouter key from the AI section
accounts.key_optional: OpenRouter can do without its own key when the AI section uses OpenRouter too: it then uses the AI key above.
accounts.footer_openrouter: OpenRouter has no speech-to-text endpoint: the audio goes to a model that can listen (Gemini), which returns the transcript.
accounts.footer_models: Used when the API is chosen in the Speech recognition tab: the file model for files, the dictation model for dictation.
accounts.keys_note: All keys are stored in your system's credential store, never written to files.
